headline: Egypt Supreme Energy Council reviews power for new industrial projects
summary: Egypt's Supreme Energy Council discussed securing electricity supplies for 11 new industrial projects and factory expansions during its 32nd meeting.
why: Industrial energy allocation is a vital prerequisite for manufacturing output, capacity expansion, and industrial sector growth in emerging economies.

impacts.name: Egyptian Industrial Sector
impacts.why: Guaranteed electricity supply enables scheduled industrial production expansions.
